capabilities: Sync notes, folders and attachments bidirectionally with Joplin Server via its delta API
Encrypt synced content end-to-end using the Joplin E2EE protocol
Merge conflicting edits with three-way merge or configurable conflict strategies
Convert wiki-links and tags to Joplin-compatible Markdown and back
Force push or force pull to reset the server or local vault, with typed confirmation
extras: README documents destructive operations in detail (force push/pull wipe the server or local vault) and E2EE caveats such as all clients needing the same password; also installable via BRAT and manual download.
problem: Obsidian's built-in sync options don't cover Joplin Server, so users with notes on a self-hosted Joplin instance have no way to keep their vault in sync with it.

relations.evidence: Bidirectional sync between Obsidian and a Joplin Server instance.

summary: Bidirectional vault sync with a Joplin Server instance, covering notes, folders, attachments, tags and links, with optional E2EE.
